text:
anna_csm: Morning team — quick EchoBridge weekly health pulse. TL;DR: tokens/day ~1.2M (-8% WoW, +18% QoQ), peak throughput ~450 TPS, avg latency p50 85ms / p95 360ms. Error rate 0.87% (+0.2pp WoW). This week's spend $18.5k; projected run-rate if trend holds ~$21k/mo. Onboarding status: 80% complete for ruling-engine rollout; outstanding item = API key rotation on staging. Renewal posture = AMBER (usage OK but errors rising + enablement gap).

jamie_se: Can you share error signatures? 5xx vs client-side? Any changes in request size or prompt length distribution?

anna_csm: Mostly 5xx from the model pool (timeout/retry surface). Saw a small bump in average tokens per request for the new document-summary flow — median tokens/request up ~22%. No config changes from CS side.

ryan_ops: Noted a deploy Tue 02:12 UTC by deploy-bot for model-swap A->A-quant. No obvious rollback. I'll pull traces for the 02:10–02:40 window.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: service=inf-serving commit=abc1234 env=prod time=2026-03-15T02:12:07Z status=success :white_check_mark:

maya_cs: I'll run an enablement refresher Wed 11:00 PT with their eng + product contacts (15–20m walk-through + FAQ). Will cover: best-practice prompts, rate-limits, and key rotation. @anna_csm can you invite them? :calendar:

anna_csm: On it — invite sent to echo-bridge@company and cc'd their PM (Jordan).

jamie_se: For diagnostics, please pull a sample of the failing request IDs and run this query in traces:
```
SELECT request_id, status_code, latency_ms, tokens_in, model_variant
FROM request_traces
WHERE service='inf-serving' AND timestamp >= '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z' AND status_code >= 500
ORDER BY latency_ms DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
I'll take the top 10 and check kernel-level OOMs or GPU queue stalls.

ryan_ops: Ran a quick grep, saw repeated `KV cache miss` and `timeout waiting for batch` logs around 02:13. Could be batching backpressure when token-length spiked.

anna_csm: Customer notes: they rolled out a larger context prompt on Monday and had a few internal retries configured. They also asked about switching to a quantized variant for cost.

billing-bot: Heads-up: forecast vs committed this billing cycle = +12% (forecast $21.2k vs committed $19k). Alert level = notice.

maya_cs: Given the spend uptick + errors, I recommend: 1) enablement session (Wed) 2) short-term routing to stable model variant for peak hours 3) follow-up re: key rotation. Volunteers?

jamie_se: I can do #2 — add a routing rule for 6–12 UTC to route heavy-context requests to stable-nonquant (lower latency). Will monitor throughput.

anna_csm: Action items: [A1] enablement session Wed 11:00 PT (owner: maya_cs) — invite sent; [A2] add temporary routing rule 06–12 UTC (owner: jamie_se) — ETA 2 hours; [A3] ops trace deep-dive for 02:00–03:00 window (owner: ryan_ops) — ETA 4 hours; [A4] billing check & spend forecast (owner: anna_csm + billing-bot) — ETA EOD Friday.

ryan_ops: I'll post the trace links once analysis done. If we see sustained queue stalls, we should consider bumping dedicated pool capacity during peak for next 48 hrs.

anna_csm: Renewal note: propose a joint enablement + 30-day technical SLA review to move status back to GREEN. If errors persist and spend keeps rising, we may need to escalate to AMBER+ (renewal risk).

maya_cs: 👍 scheduling follow-up 30-day checkpoint.

jamie_se: Quick check: current 7d avg tokens/request = 2.3k, requests/sec (7d peak) = 480 RPS, baseline batching config = max_batch_size 64, max_latency_ms 80. If p95 stays >300ms we'll lower max_batch_size to 32 for the heavy-context path.

anna_csm: Thanks all — I'll update EchoBridge after the enablement and share the action tracker here. Will reopen thread if anything urgent pops up. :thumbsup:
